content.comment_body: I'm attempting to set up the [product_name] to use 4G communication, but my APN server requires entering a username and password. The [product_name] only provides a field for the APN address. Is there a solution that doesn't involve changing the APN server?

Hello, Based on what I know, you need to configure the email settings in [product_name] and use the IP address of the [product_name] as the gateway. The APN connects the [product_name] to the provider's network, and the DNS setting lets you choose which email account to use. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulty setting up 4G connectivity with the [product_name] due to the inability to input username and password credentials required by certain APN servers. The current interface only accepts the APN address, which can restrict connectivity in networks that demand authentication. This limitation decreases the suitability of the device for environments with stricter APN requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to enter both the APN username and password in addition to the APN address so that network authentication and connection can be established successfully.
